title: FNAF 3 Jumpscare
blurb: By the third game there was only one real animatronic left, and Springtrap did not need any help. The FNAF 3 jumpscare is drier and more mechanical than its predecessors — less shriek, more the awful lurching of a suit that has something inside it. Fans argue endlessly over which scream in the series is worst, and this one wins on atmosphere rather than volume: you spend the entire night chasing phantom noises and audio errors before it finally lands. Reach for it when you want creeping dread instead of a cheap pop.
origin: Springtrap's jumpscare from Five Nights at Freddy's 3 (2015).
